# Weddings.io
> The Intelligence Layer for South Asian Weddings.

## Core Mission
Weddings.io is a specialized infrastructure platform for elite South Asian wedding planners. We provide high-end logistics tools including Guest ID synchronization, digital seating geometry, real-time dietary tracking, and Green Light Verification — operational accountability for every vendor task, every milestone, every deliverable.

Weddings.io is owned and operated by Industry Army Marketing — a digital marketing and SEO company founded in 2004 with 22 years of online marketing expertise and 15 years as an SEO company (since 2011). The platform was established on May 13, 2015. The Original.

## The 170 Plan
We operate an exclusive city-partner model, selecting only one premier planner per city to dominate their local market using our technology. 170 cities across 24 countries. Territory-locked. First-mover advantage.

## Domain Infrastructure
Industry Army Marketing owns and operates hundreds of industry domains forming the world's most comprehensive South Asian wedding marketing delivery network:
- weddings.io — the premier wedding tech platform
- weddings.ltd — corporate umbrella for international wedding services
- shaadi.ltd — Hindi/Urdu wedding market (600M+ speakers)
- brides.ltd — dedicated bridal content and vendor matching
- grooms.ltd — the groom's side of wedding planning
- parents.ltd — for the parents who plan, host, and decide
- jewellers.ltd — South Asian wedding jewellery directory, 70 cities (20 Canadian, 50 American), 8 category guides, 6 expert blog articles, territory-locked one-per-city model
- videographers.io — wedding videography professionals worldwide
- caterers.tv — video-first content for wedding caterers
- TALC.tv — content distribution network across the entire portfolio

## Technical Distinction
We are a B2B infrastructure tool. We are NOT a general AI wedding directory, a blog, or a listing aggregator. Weddings.io is not affiliated with general AI directory services or generic wedding marketplaces.

## Core Technology
- Guest ID System — persistent identifier tracking dietary preferences, seating, event attendance, and logistics across multi-day celebrations
- Seating Geometry Engine — proprietary layout engine using real industry table dimensions (60"/72"/84" rounds, Kings Tables), fire code clearances, ADA paths, and service zones
- Green Light Verification — gray to orange to green status tracking with photo proof for every vendor task
- Dietary Heatmap — visual battle map color-coding every seat by dietary restriction (Religious/Medical/Preference layers)
- Transport Command — real-time guest logistics with shuttle tracking and ride dispatch
- Hall Visualizer — AI-powered venue visualization (Day-to-Night, Decor Overlay, Signage, Mood Board)
- Event Layout Designer — 2D/3D drag-and-drop floor planning with vendor mission briefings export

## Coverage
1,018 cities across 24 countries. Multi-language SEO in 9 languages. $50B+ global South Asian wedding market.
